div.div:
Deployment workflow-worker-exit-a
1 replica, strategy Recreate, label wdf.dev/build-id=exit-a
memory 256Mi request = limit, cpu 250m / 500m
readiness: test -e /tmp/wdf-ready
python -m wdf_workflow.service, one process:
workflow worker: wdf-workflow, build exit-a of wdf-workflow-worker
control worker: wdf-control-exit-a
reaper worker: wdf-artifact-reaper
metrics :9464
